# Sound Relief

> > Sound Relief provides expert tinnitus and hearing care through The Sound Relief Method, combining tinnitus retraining therapy and audiological services across Colorado and Arizona locations.

Sound Relief is a specialized hearing and tinnitus treatment center with multiple clinic locations staffed by experienced audiologists including Dr. Gina Gates, Dr. Julie Prutsman, and Dr. Abby McMahon. The practice focuses on comprehensive hearing assessments, hearing aids, and evidence-based tinnitus management using TRT-based approaches.

## Key Topics

- Tinnitus Retraining Therapy (TRT)
- The Sound Relief Method
- Hearing loss treatment
- Hearing aids and CROS systems
- Audiologist services
- Hyperacusis management
- Colorado and Arizona locations
- Dr. Gina Gates
- Dr. Julie Prutsman
- Dr. Abby McMahon
- Audiological assessments
- New patient consultations
- Appointment scheduling
- Denver, Fort Collins, Boulder clinics

## Appointments & Locations

- [Book Your Hearing Appointment Today](https://soundrelief.com/schedule-an-appointment): Schedule hearing assessments and consultations at Sound Relief locations in Denver, Fort Collins, and Golden.
- [Our Hearing Clinic Locations](https://soundrelief.com/locations): Directory of Sound Relief clinic locations across Arizona and Colorado for tinnitus and hearing care.

## Clinic Locations

- [Denver Tinnitus & Hearing Center](https://soundrelief.com/locations/sound-relief-tinnitus-hearing-center-denver): Denver clinic page featuring TRT-based tinnitus treatment and hearing care from Dr. Gina Gates and Dr. Julie Prutsman.
- [Fort Collins Tinnitus & Hearing Center](https://soundrelief.com/locations/sound-relief-tinnitus-hearing-center-fort-collins): Fort Collins clinic offering tinnitus retraining therapy and hearing care services with Dr. Abby McMahon.
